features.quote: Iteration Cap: 25 iterations. A run terminates early only if the model outputs a specific <GIVE_UP> token or completely breaks formatting for 3 consecutive turns.
To prevent context window exhaustion (which causes mechanical failure, not behavioral failure), the environment only feeds back the last 3 tracebacks/logs.
features.justification_quote: context window exhaustion (which causes mechanical failure, not behavioral failure)
